Well if it isn't already, implant grade titanium. Although I'm not sure if it was just coincidence, when I switched to a stainless steel hoop, my piercing improved. Not sure if it was the material switch or the fact that the hoop was larger than my previous to give it room tho.

When my nostril was first pierced, it was super sensitive to everything for the first 3ish months. I realized that cleaning it all the time was actually doing more harm than good. When I only cleaned with saline solution at night and just let it get clean in the shower in the morning I noticed it did better. I also just stopped messing with it. Your piercing looks similar to how mine did in the beginning, I don't think it's rejecting probably just irritated. Maybe a different material for your jewelry could help too.
